label: parse-figjam, found with gh search, is a read-back-only skill over FigJam REST JSON and fills the board-as-data role no pinned source covers.
parse-figjam reads only semantic fields and ignores fifteen layout/appearance fields, enabling a cheaper deterministic read-back than Flow Mode's screenshot comparison.
parse-figjam derives connector direction from stroke caps, a check Flow Mode's read-back never performs.
parse-figjam treats strokeDashes as a distinct relationship type, a semantic Flow Mode cannot express because it has no dashed/solid rule.
parse-figjam maps colour meaning from a legend section or asks the user, while Flow Mode has neither a legend convention nor a colour-meaning record.
parse-figjam surfaces unknown node types and missing endpoints instead of skipping them, an unknown-item category Flow Mode's read-back lacks.
parse-figjam never reproduces the full JSON tree, corroborating bounded read-back across iterations 2, 3, 6 and 7.
TD-only verdict: keep top-to-bottom as the default house style and reject it as a generator rule, since four corpus sources accept or prefer LR.
Nine-node verdict: keep the cap, but require anything omitted by a split to be named, since official caps near 20 and ompug near 25 while the densest practitioner example is exactly 9.
Three-exit verdict: keep unchanged; official decision trees and rocket-path's examples both use three labelled exits.
One-accent verdict: change the unit from distinct hex to accent family, because official permits semantic multi-colour and IamTheLime keeps note and warning roles beside MAIN.
Four-shape verdict: keep, with the vendor table as justification, since rectangle, stadium, circle-as-ellipse and diamond all render distinctly while most other shapes fall back.
parse-figjam can emit Mermaid from a board, exposing the round-trip capability Flow Mode lacks when revising an existing board from its model.
